meta.name: video-extend
meta.description: Extend or continue an existing video clip on RunComfy via the `runcomfy` CLI. Routes to Google Veo 3-1's `extend-video` and `fast/extend-video` endpoints — pick the source video plus a prompt describing what should happen next, and the model produces a clip that continues the original with consistent motion, lighting, and subject identity. Use when the user has a short Veo clip and wants it longer, or wants a chained narrative built shot-by-shot from a single seed clip. Triggers on "extend video", "continue video", "longer video", "video extend", "make this clip longer", "Veo extend", "chain video shots", "video continuation", or any explicit ask to take an existing video and add more frames after it.

copy.tagline: 延长现有视频片段，保持画面连贯一致
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你有一段短视频想让它变得更长或延续故事
copy.tagline_en: Extend your existing video clip with consistent motion and lighting
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a short video clip and want to make it longer or continue the story

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能把你提供的一段短视频延长，生成后续画面，保持动作、光线和主体一致。它使用 Google Veo 3-1 模型，通过 RunComfy CLI 执行。
howto.when: 当你提到“延长视频”、“继续视频”、“让这个片段更长”等关键词，或者明确要求给现有视频增加更多帧时触发。

say.text: 帮我延长这段视频，让镜头继续推进。
用快速模式延长这个片段，加 5 秒。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude can extend a short video clip you provide, generating subsequent frames that maintain consistent motion, lighting, and subject identity. It uses Google Veo 3-1 via the RunComfy CLI.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention "extend video", "continue video", "make this clip longer", or explicitly ask to add more frames after an existing video.

say_en.text: Extend this video, keep the camera pushing in.
say_en.note: Claude will call Veo 3-1 Extend to generate the continuation.

say_en.text: Use fast mode to extend this clip by 5 seconds.
say_en.note: Claude will use the Fast Extend endpoint for quicker results.
